steps.name: o1b-1-hook-spike
steps.verify: set -o pipefail && bash -n bin/delegate bin/delegate-wake install.sh worker/entrypoint.sh claude/spikes/run.sh claude/spikes/probe-*.sh && python3 -m py_compile lib/*.py && bash tests/test_spikes.sh && for t in tests/test_*.sh; do bash "$t" || exit 1; done && ! git diff --name-only main -- ':(exclude)config.example.env' | grep -qvE '^(claude/spikes/|tests/|docs/specs/)'
